paite: TOUPA aw kei hon doute pung hi na mahmah uh e! Kei hon sualte tampi ahi uh;
heading: Atapa Absalom A Kipan Ataimang Lai A / David La
english: A Psalm by David, when he fled from Absalom his son. Yahweh, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.

paite: amah a ding in Pathian ah panpihna himhim a-om kei, chi a, ka hinna tungtang thugente tampi a-om uhi. Selah
english: Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.” Selah.

paite: Himahleh, TOUPA aw, nang ka thupina leh ka kim ka vel in ka phaw na hi a; ka lu domkangpa na hi.
english: But you, Yahweh, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.

paite: Ka aw in TOUPA ka sam a, amual siangthou a kipan in ahon dawng zel hi. Selah
english: I cry to Yahweh with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah.

paite: Kei ka lum in ka na ihmuta a; ka khanglou nawn a; TOUPA'N ahon na len gige ahi.
english: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for Yahweh sustains me.

paite: Hon dou a, hon umsuakte, mi singkhat nangawn ka kihta kei ding.
english: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.

paite: TOUPA aw, thou inla; ka Pathian aw, hon hondam in; kei hon doute teng abiangguh uah na khen pah a; Pathian limsak lou mite ha na kikhongsak a;
english: Arise, Yahweh! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.

paite: hotdamna tuh TOUPA a ahi; na vualzawlna na mite tung ah om hen. Selah
english: Salvation belongs to Yahweh. May your blessing be on your people. Selah.
